business_impact_plausible.detail: Q2 records and tallies put walk-aways, comped drinks, remakes, and peak-end overtime near $4,000 for the quarter -- roughly $16,000 a year if nothing changes.

data_obtainable.detail: The POS exports order timestamps to CSV daily; the shift lead trialed a phone-stopwatch handoff tally for two mornings in June and it held up during rush.

measurable_outcome.detail: Order-to-handoff time in minutes per order, lower is better: the POS stamps the order time, and handoff time comes from a tally sheet at the pickup counter.

artifact.notes: Routing note: all five criteria are Yes, and the problem is too big for the PDCA quick path -- there is no single obvious fix (queueing at the register, machine contention, and pileup at handoff are all suspects), so it needs a measured baseline and real cause verification. Route: full DMAIC.

process_owner_engaged.detail: Priya Shah, morning shift lead, runs the counter and asked for the project after June's walk-away complaints; cafe manager Dana Ellis sponsors it.

scope_narrow.detail: Espresso-drink orders during the weekday 7:00-10:00 morning peak at the campus coffee bar -- not food, not drip-only orders, not weekends, not the library cart.
